card.name: Just before device failure or breakdown
card.fires_on: Words right before a failure or malfunction word is expected, such as 'Mal' in 'Malfunction', 'of' or 'pump' in 'in case of pump failure', and 'breaks' or 'broke' for equipment. Mostly insulin pump text, with some general talk of machines breaking.

modes.label: Insulin pump failure
modes.description: Words leading into 'failure' or 'malfunction' in insulin pump warnings.
modes.example: Hyperglycemia and Ketoacidosis Due to Insulin Pump Device<< Mal>>function: Monitor glucose and administer KIRST

modes.label: Backup in case of failure
modes.description: 'of' or 'pump' in the phrase 'in case of (insulin) pump failure'.
modes.example: have alternate insulin therapy available in case<< of>> pump failure [see How Supplied/

modes.label: Everyday equipment breaking
modes.description: Verbs meaning a machine stops working in general web text.
modes.example: - If the computer<< breaks>>, will children not know how to write

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words about malfunction, faults and technical troubleshooting.
card.plain: It fires on the words just before a device is said to fail or malfunction, mainly insulin pumps.
